About Me

Blending Corporate Leadership with a Passion for Mentoring

Roots & Early Beginnings

Born in the serene foothills of the Himalayan Shivalik range in Hariana, Punjab, my foundational years were shaped by a profound legacy of education, literature, and patriotism. Raised by two dedicated teachers — my mother Kamaljit Kaur, and my father Jagjit Singh Komal, a celebrated Punjabi poet and satirist — I grew up in a culturally vibrant and intellectually stimulating environment.

My drive for leadership emerged early. While completing my BA at Government College, Hoshiarpur, I founded and managed a grocery business for four years — instilling operational resilience and customer-centricity long before I ever stepped into a corporate boardroom.

A Pan-India Corporate Ascent

In 2003, I transitioned to Gurgaon to launch my professional journey with IBM Daksh. Over 20+ years, my career has been a dynamic pan-India adventure — Delhi NCR, Pune, Jaipur, Chandigarh, and now Bangalore.

I have had the privilege of architecting capability development and cultural transformation for world-leading brands including Realme, Huawei, Reliance, Mary Kay Cosmetics, and currently, Café Coffee Day.
